MEDICATIONS: 
1. Oxybutynin ER 10 mg PO once daily for stent-related bladder spasms.

2. PCP f/u in 4 wks on Mon, Nov 23, 2026 at 2:00 PM for BP check and med review. 

If any questions, call urology triage at 555-0100. 

All prescriptions sent to pharmacy on file. 

Signed: Dr. A. Patel, Urology
